verdict.rationale: Datalab offers some AI-assisted automation—auto-generating extraction schemas for a document (datalab-docs-41) and running 'agent processors' on documents (datalab-docs-40)—which could be seen as AI suggesting how to interpret/extract data. However, there's no evidence of broader analytical insights, summaries, trend detection, or proactive suggestions about data content beyond structured extraction. missing for 10: evidence of AI-generated summaries/insights beyond schema suggestion, evidence of in-product analytics or pattern detection, and any independent corroboration of these agentic features actually surfacing insights to users.
